hypothesis: On a GGUF, an expert cache one slot larger than the 8 GB Mac's default (264 slots instead of 263, for the layer-by-layer prompt) leaves the speed of the 32 decode steps after a 512-token prompt as it was on an 8 GB M1.
model: unsloth's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf (22,134,528,992 bytes, downloaded to this Mac's SSD on 2026-10-18, finished at 23:34), in the directory coli import --mode link makes for it (gguf.json, config.json, tokenizer.json): dense matrices in Q8_0, the head in Q6_K, the embedding in Q8_0, the routers and the DeltaNet's alpha and beta projections in F32, the routed experts' gate and up in Q4_K and their down in Q5_K (37 layers) or Q6_K (3)
command: git archive <commit> c | tar -x -C <dir>, make -C <dir>/c qwen36_metal.o backend_metal.o METAL=1, then from the repository root, with the compiler flags make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 gives qwen36.c except its qpack path (-DQWEN36_QPACK and its objects, which the harness does not use): clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-gguf-metal-2026-10-19/bench.c <dir>/c/qwen36_metal.o <dir>/c/backend_metal.o -o bin-<commit>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp -framework Metal -framework Foundation -framework Accelerate -lc++; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME TEACHER=1 launchers/<name>/qwen36-bench chat.txt 64,512 32, where each launcher is a script of one line that sets SNAP and its variables and runs a harness; baseline = launchers/gguf/, trial = launchers/gguf-264-slots/: the same harness (bin-08293922/) and file, the default budget against one slot more

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.BUILD: the compiler flags of make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 on macOS without its qpack path: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL, qwen36_metal.o and backend_metal.o
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of chat.txt (an English conversation written for these measurements, plain User:/Assistant: text, read whole; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 tokens, each fed the text's own next token (teacher forcing: both versions read the same tokens)
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run of the baseline (discarded; both versions read the same file), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.EXPERT_CACHE: slots of 2.04 MB (the file's largest expert), QWEN_EXPERT_CACHE_BYTES below
config.MEASURED: tokens per second of decode steps 2 to 32 after the 512-token prompt, each step fed the text's next token (teacher forcing)
config.QWEN_EXPERT_CACHE_BYTES: unset: the default budget, a sixteenth of the RAM (512 MiB), holds 263 slots (536,469,504 bytes), 255 retained, so a prompt loads its experts eight at a time

quality.method: Correctness: both versions were fed the same tokens (teacher forcing: the hash of the tokens is the same in every run of both); the budget changes which experts the cache holds and how a prompt's experts are grouped, not the arithmetic of a product. Fingerprints of every logit and hashes of the tokens (baseline / trial), each the same in every run of its version: 64 tokens 88ce147048ad7765/f55beb9e5e71ac78 / 88ce147048ad7765/f55beb9e5e71ac78, 512 tokens 33d594906f36b78b/99b2135657766012 / 33d594906f36b78b/99b2135657766012; the 32 tokens' mean negative log-likelihood and top-1 rate (baseline / trial): after 64 tokens 2.02861 0.531 / 2.02861 0.531, after 512 tokens 1.81011 0.469 / 1.81011 0.469.
